scenarios.title: Device Platform, OS Version & Environmental Health
scenarios.description: Verify hardware model, OS version compliance, uptime, CPU/Memory utilization, power supplies, and fan status.

vendor_commands.Cisco: show version; show environment all; show processes cpu; show ntp status; show logging
vendor_commands.Arista: show version; show environment all; show ntp status; show processes top
vendor_commands.Juniper: show version; show chassis environment; show ntp associations
vendor_commands.Palo Alto: show system info; show system resources; show ntp; show admins
vendor_commands.Fortinet: get system status; get system performance status; get system ntp
vendor_commands.Aruba: show system; show version; show environment; show ap database
vendor_commands.Huawei: display version; display environment; display cpu-usage; display memory
vendor_commands.Mikrotik: /system resource print; /system routerboard print; /system health print
vendor_commands.Dell: show version; show environment; show processes cpu
vendor_commands.CheckPoint: show version all; show asset all; show sysenv all
vendor_commands.Default: show version; show environment; show processes

scenarios.recommendation: Maintain vendor-recommended stable golden image OS and replace faulty environmental hardware.

scenarios.title: Management Protocol Synchronization (NTP, DNS, Syslog, SNMP, AAA)
scenarios.description: Validate NTP clock synchronization, primary/secondary DNS servers, remote syslog logging, and SNMP trap communities.

vendor_commands.Cisco: show line vty 0 4; show aaa servers; show ntp status; show snmp group
vendor_commands.Arista: show aaa; show ssh; show ntp status; show snmp
vendor_commands.Juniper: show system ntp; show system radius-server; show snmp
vendor_commands.Palo Alto: show admins; show ntp; show snmp info; show system services
vendor_commands.Fortinet: get system admin status; get system snmp sysinfo; get system ntp
vendor_commands.Aruba: show aaa authentication; show ntp servers; show snmp-server
vendor_commands.Huawei: display ntp status; display radius-server configuration; display snmp-agent sys-info
vendor_commands.Default: show ntp; show snmp; show aaa

scenarios.recommendation: Enforce synchronized NTP across all nodes and configure redundant AAA/Syslog servers.

scenarios.title: Physical Interface Operational State & Speed/Duplex
scenarios.description: Verify admin/operational status, auto-negotiation, port speed, MTU consistency, and interface descriptions.

vendor_commands.Cisco: show interfaces status; show interfaces description; show ip interface brief
vendor_commands.Arista: show interfaces status; show interfaces description
vendor_commands.Juniper: show interfaces terse; show interfaces descriptions
vendor_commands.Palo Alto: show interface all; show interface logical
vendor_commands.Fortinet: get system interface; diagnose hardware deviceinfo nic
vendor_commands.Aruba: show interface brief; show interface port-utilization
vendor_commands.Huawei: display interface brief; display interface description
vendor_commands.Default: show interfaces status; show interface brief

scenarios.recommendation: Resolve mismatched link speeds, correct interface MTU across peer links, and document descriptions.

scenarios.title: Interface Counter Errors, Drops & CRC Health
scenarios.description: Verify absence of alignment errors, FCS/CRC error increments, packet discards, collisions, and err-disabled states.

vendor_commands.Cisco: show interfaces counters errors; show interfaces | include CRC|drops
vendor_commands.Arista: show interfaces counters errors; show interfaces counters discards
vendor_commands.Palo Alto: show interface counters; show counter global
vendor_commands.Fortinet: diagnose netlink interface list; diagnose hardware nic
vendor_commands.Huawei: display interface counters error; display interface | include CRC

scenarios.recommendation: Inspect physical cabling, clean optical transceivers, and reset err-disabled interfaces.

scenarios.title: CDP Neighbor Adjacency & Expected Peer Topology Match
scenarios.description: Verify CDP neighbor table against physical topology design. Ensure local interface, remote interface, and device platform consistency.
scenarios.recommendation: Ensure CDP is enabled on internal infrastructure links and disabled on external boundary ports.

scenarios.title: LLDP Neighbor Chassis ID & Port Information
scenarios.description: Validate multi-vendor LLDP neighbor table, system capabilities, and remote management address consistency.
scenarios.recommendation: Standardize LLDP on multi-vendor uplinks and AP connections for automated inventory discovery.

scenarios.title: VLAN Database, Active VLAN IDs & Name Consistency
scenarios.description: Verify standard VLANs (Data, Voice, Management, Native), ensure active state, and validate cross-switch VLAN consistency.

vendor_commands.Cisco: show vlan brief; show vlan summary

scenarios.recommendation: Maintain synchronized VLAN IDs and consistent naming across all switching layers.

scenarios.title: 802.1Q Trunk Status, Native VLAN & Allowed VLAN List
scenarios.description: Verify trunk operational state, consistent native VLAN (non-default VLAN 1), and explicit allowed VLAN filtering on inter-switch uplinks.

vendor_commands.Cisco: show interfaces trunk; show interfaces switchport | include Mode|Native
vendor_commands.Huawei: display port vlan; display interface trunk

scenarios.recommendation: Prune unused VLANs on trunk links and change default native VLAN from 1 to a dedicated unused VLAN.

scenarios.title: Spanning-Tree Protocol Mode, Root Bridge & Guard Protection
scenarios.description: Verify STP mode (Rapid-PVST/MST), designated Root Bridge priorities, blocking ports, and BPDU Guard/Root Guard on edge interfaces.

vendor_commands.Cisco: show spanning-tree summary; show spanning-tree detail | include is the root; show spanning-tree root
vendor_commands.Juniper: show spanning-tree bridge; show spanning-tree interface
vendor_commands.Huawei: display stp brief; display stp root

scenarios.recommendation: Set primary and secondary root bridge priorities explicitly and enable BPDU Guard on all access ports.

scenarios.title: EtherChannel Port-Channel Bundling & LACP Negotiation
scenarios.description: Validate member port aggregation, active LACP negotiation, duplex/speed/VLAN consistency across bundled physical links.

vendor_commands.Cisco: show etherchannel summary; show etherchannel port-channel; show lacp internal
vendor_commands.Arista: show port-channel summary; show lacp internal
vendor_commands.Juniper: show interfaces ae terse; show lacp interfaces
vendor_commands.Default: show etherchannel summary; show port-channel summary

scenarios.recommendation: Standardize on 802.3ad dynamic LACP and verify identical physical port configurations before bundling.

scenarios.title: OSPF Neighbor Adjacencies, Router-ID & Area Consistency
scenarios.description: Verify OSPF process ID, unique Router-IDs, Full neighbor adjacencies, timer synchronization (Hello/Dead), and passive interfaces.

vendor_commands.Cisco: show ip ospf neighbor; show ip ospf interface brief; show ip ospf database
vendor_commands.Arista: show ip ospf neighbor; show ip ospf interface brief
vendor_commands.Juniper: show ospf neighbor; show ospf interface
vendor_commands.Fortinet: get router info ospf neighbor; get router info ospf status
vendor_commands.Huawei: display ospf peer brief; display ospf interface
vendor_commands.Default: show ip ospf neighbor; show ip ospf interface

scenarios.recommendation: Ensure unique 32-bit loopback Router-IDs and configure passive-interface default for security.

scenarios.title: BGP Peer Session State, AS Numbers & Prefix Exchange
scenarios.description: Verify BGP Established state, local/remote AS numbers, update-source loopback, route-maps, and prefix advertised/received counts.

vendor_commands.Cisco: show ip bgp summary; show ip bgp neighbors; show ip bgp
vendor_commands.Arista: show ip bgp summary; show ip bgp neighbors
vendor_commands.Juniper: show bgp summary; show bgp neighbor
vendor_commands.Palo Alto: show routing protocol bgp summary; show routing protocol bgp peer
vendor_commands.Fortinet: get router info bgp summary; get router info bgp neighbors
vendor_commands.Huawei: display bgp peer; display bgp routing-table

scenarios.recommendation: Configure MD5 authentication on external eBGP peers and apply inbound/outbound route filtering.

scenarios.title: HSRP / VRRP First Hop Redundancy, Priority & Preemption
scenarios.description: Validate active/standby router roles, Virtual IP (VIP) consistency, priority decrements on uplink failure, and preemption settings.

vendor_commands.Cisco: show standby brief; show standby neighbors; show vrrp brief
vendor_commands.Default: show standby brief; show vrrp brief

scenarios.recommendation: Align FHRP active router priorities with primary STP Root Bridge positions to avoid asymmetric routing.

scenarios.title: Firewall Security Policy Rule Base & Any/Any Mitigation
scenarios.description: Audit active firewall rules, source/destination zone constraints, application-ID inspection, and verify no overly broad Any/Any rules.

vendor_commands.Palo Alto: show running security-rule; show zones; show high-availability all
vendor_commands.Fortinet: show firewall policy; get system ha status; show system interface
vendor_commands.Cisco: show running-config access-list; show conn count
vendor_commands.Default: show firewall policy; show security rules

scenarios.recommendation: Enforce strict least-privilege security policies, eliminate any/any rules, and enable active logging.

scenarios.title: Access Point Radio Status, Channel Utilization & SSID Profiles
scenarios.description: Verify AP associations to controller, 2.4GHz/5GHz radio power levels, channel overlap mitigation, and WPA3/802.1X security.

vendor_commands.Aruba: show ap database; show wlan summary; show ap radio-summary; show ap active
vendor_commands.Cisco: show ap summary; show wlan summary; show ap dot11 5ghz summary; show ap dot11 24ghz summary
vendor_commands.Default: show ap summary; show wlan summary

scenarios.recommendation: Enable dynamic channel assignment (RRM/ARM) and enforce WPA2-Enterprise/WPA3 encryption on corporate SSIDs.
